# opnsense_syslog_destination (Data Source)

Remote syslog destinations (**System ▸ Settings ▸ Logging ▸ Remote**). Each destination forwards the selected programs, levels and facilities to a remote collector.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the syslog destination.

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) Refid of the client certificate used for TLS transports.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this destination is enabled.
- `facility` (Set of String) Facilities to forward, e.g. `local0`. Empty forwards all.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname or IP address of the remote collector.
- `level` (Set of String) Severities to forward. Empty forwards all.
- `port` (Number) Port of the remote collector.
- `program` (Set of String) Programs to forward, e.g. `filterlog`. Empty forwards all.
- `rfc5424` (Boolean) When enabled, messages are sent in RFC 5424 format instead of the BSD format.
- `transport` (String) Transport protocol and address family.
